summary: The filing is an 8-K by Partners Group Lending Fund disclosing its July 31, 2026 net asset value per unit and portfolio statistics. It reports Class I and M unit NAV of $1.5036, aggregate NAV of approximately $318.3 million with $224.0 million debt outstanding, and a $506.6 million portfolio across 64 borrowers, with 94.4% first lien/unitranche loans. This is routine periodic disclosure of fund performance and holdings, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms or corporate actions are involved; the filing includes only standard operational updates for a business development company. No transaction risk or arbitrage angle applies.
